item.g:title: Cookies - Classic Chocolate Chip Cookie
item.g:description: Baked fresh daily, the cookies at The Good Batch are what made us a Brooklyn favorite. From classic chocolate chip and confetti to buttercrunch, tahini chocolate chunk, peanut butter, and toast & jam, every cookie strikes the perfect balance of nostalgic and unexpected. Order online for delivery, stop by the shop, or add our cookies to your next catered event. Prices reflected here are for one dozen (12) cookies. Please reach out to us if you'd like to order cookies in smaller quantities!
